artworks.title: François de l'Hospital du Hallier
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.8 x 14 cm (8 9/16 x 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an oval-shaped portrait featuring the upper torso of a man positioned facing slightly to his right, but looking directly at the viewer. His face is characterized by a prominent, pointed mustache and a small, pointed beard. His long hair, which extends past his shoulders, is wavy and parted in the middle. He is dressed in a suit of armor with decorative rivets, over which there appears to be a sash draped from his left shoulder to his right hip. The portrait is framed by an elaborate border containing text encircling the image. Below the oval, there is an ornate coat of arms and additional text. The background within the oval is textured with a tightly spaced pattern that contrasts with the smoother depiction of the man.

artworks.title: Jean Charles Doria
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.6 x 14.3 cm (7 11/16 x 5 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man in a bust portrait. He is positioned facing forward with his body turned slightly to the right, his right hand resting upon a sheathed sword. The man's facial features include a prominent nose, high cheekbones, a well-defined chin, and a large mustache that curls at the ends. His hair is wavy and receding. He wears a detailed, ruffled collar and a cloak, suggesting a sense of nobility or high status. The background consists of etched lines that create a subtle gradient effect, emphasizing the figure's prominence within an oval frame. Latin text encircles the border of the oval.

artworks.title: Louis II de Bourbon
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person's upper body in a three-quarter view. The individual has curly, shoulder-length hair, a prominent nose, and a calm expression. They are wearing armor and a decorative sash, with a high-collared shirt visible underneath. Surrounding the figure is an ornate wreath, and at the bottom is a coat of arms with crowns and fleur-de-lis within a shield. The background has a pattern of concentric lines.

artworks.title: Mathieu Mole
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, slightly turned to the left. He has a composed expression with noticeable facial features including a sharp nose, dark arched eyebrows, and a neatly groomed full beard and mustache. His hair is short and combed back with a slightly receding hairline. He is wearing a dark garment with a large white square collar and a textured layer, possibly a cloak or a drape. On the left side is an ornate coat of arms with detailed scrollwork and a crown-like element. The background features a simple textured pattern.

artworks.title: The Ecstasy of Saint Francis [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Rudolf J. Heinemann, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of angelic figures in a dynamic, celestial scene. The composition presents gracefully sketched angelic beings, with emphasis on flow and movement through the use of curvilinear lines and gestural brushstrokes. Several of these figures appear to be winged, suggesting a scene lifted from the heavens, rich with motion and energy. The drawing is executed with pen and brown ink washes, creating contrasts and a sense of depth. There is a sense of interaction among the figures, depicted in an etheric and dream-like setting.

artworks.title: Biblical Scene [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Rudolf J. Heinemann, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in various poses. The artist uses quick, gestural strokes to depict movement and interaction among the figures. The background consists of abstract lines and shapes.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Caesar: The Senators
artworks.medium: engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 28.2 x 27.1 cm (11 1/8 x 10 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an architectural setting. The scene depicts various figures clad in flowing robes and armor, gathered in front of a large stone building with arched doorways and visible battlements. In the background, there is a cylindrical tower with decorative elements. The architectural elements suggest a classical influence with detailed brickwork and arches. The figures are holding different objects such as books and staffs. Above the main scene, there is an elevated balcony with additional figures looking over the gathering below. The shading and line work are intricate, creating a sense of depth and detail throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Young Woman with Braided Hair and a Veil
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed pencil drawing of a person from the shoulders up, facing slightly to the right. The subject's head is turned to display the side of their face. The facial features, including expressive eyes, and intricately drawn hair with a braided headband, are depicted. The person's clothing is minimally sketched with a high collar, and the background is plain. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with the Parable of the Sower
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed landscape illustration with various elements from the field in the foreground to the mountains in the distance. The horizon is high, with clouds and birds in the sky. The illustration uses fine lines to depict details like farmland, trees, and a town near the mountains. The color scheme is monochromatic with black and white shades. A figure stands in the fields, and a wooden house is placed to the right. Buildings are visible near the mountains.

artworks.title: Alexander the Great and Bucephalus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a horse, human figures, and a natural backdrop. The composition shows an interaction between a figure and a rearing horse, with another figure nearby. The background includes natural elements resembling trees, with flowing lines indicating movement. Ink wash techniques are used to create depth and highlight the forms. The drawing has flowing lines and expressive contours, typical of baroque sketches, focusing on action and expression. The sepia tones add an antiquated quality to the artwork.

artworks.title: The Meeting of Antony and Cleopatra
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on buff paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. The person on the left is bent over towards the two figures on the right. This individual wears a plumed helmet and a draped garment. The figures on the right stand upright. One wears a gown with elaborate collars and sleeves, and the other stands slightly behind with softer facial features and a subtle hairstyle. The artwork is done in a sketch style with ink or wash. The background is plain, drawing attention to the interaction between the figures.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.medium: brush and black ink, heightened with white, on dark brown prepared paper; the surface varnished
artworks.description: The image depicts figures mourning over a deceased figure. The figures are gathered around the central figure, with one standing and raising their hands, while others appear to support the central figure. The background includes a ladder. The emotional intensity is conveyed through the expression and posture of the figures, capturing the solemnity and grief of the scene.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Wearing a Hat with a Medallion
artworks.medium: colored chalks on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a side profile view. He has a long nose, a subtle mustache, a thin beard along his jawline, and medium-length hair that falls around his ears. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a round, decorative element on the side. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Red Squirrel
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over traces of graphite on parchment
artworks.description: This is a painting of a squirrel with a bushy tail and pointed ears. Its fur is a rich, warm reddish-brown, with patches of white on its chest and stomach. The squirrel is depicted facing slightly to the left, sitting on its haunches with its tail curling upwards behind it and its front paws raised to its mouth, holding a small, round, brown object. Its black eyes are large and framed by its long dark whiskers. The background is neutral, off-white parchment.

artworks.title: Study of Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash, yellow and white chalks over traces of graphite on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a group of tall trees dominating the scene with their textured bark and detailed branches. The horizon is set low with a hint of pale yellow light in the distance, against a light sky. The brushstrokes vary in intensity, depicting leaves and bark with fine lines for branches and denser strokes for the trunk's texture. The color palette includes earthy tones like browns, grays, and muted green, with a warm yellow glow in the distance.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper, mounted on canvas (on strainer/stretcher)
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man facing the viewer. He has light, curly hair styled in an 18th century fashion. The man has a composed expression, fair complexion, prominent cheekbones, and a long, straight nose. He wears a dark coat with large buttons, a high-collared white shirt, and a detailed white lace cravat. The background is a muted brown. No jewelry or additional objects are visible.

artworks.title: The Public in the Salon of the Louvre, Viewing the Painting of the "Sacre"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and watercolor over traces of graphite on laid paper

artworks.title: Madame Ditte
artworks.medium: black conté crayon, black chalk and blue pastel, stumping and erasure, with touches of white on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a portrait depicting the upper portion of a woman's body. She is facing the camera with a slight turn of her head to the left. The woman has soft facial features and a serene expression. Her hair is styled in a braided updo. She is wearing a dark high-collared garment with a subtle white line visible. The background is dark and textured, emphasizing the woman's features. The portrait appears to be a sketch or drawing, possibly created with charcoal or pencil.

artworks.title: Mascaras crueles (Cruel Masks) [recto]
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and gray wash with scraping on laid paper

artworks.title: Brujas à volar (Witches Preparing to Fly) [verso]
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: Created with black ink and gray washes on cream-white paper, this drawing shows a person with a pig’s face sitting astride the shoulders of a person with goat’s legs, both looking at a book held open by two people wearing robes and tall, conical hats. The creature with goat's legs sits on the floor, legs stretched in front of it. It grips the ankles of the pig-headed person, who looks at the book with with palms raised to shoulder height and facing out. The robed people hold the book open with long pincers and look at the pair of imaginary creatures with their eyes and mouths wide open. On the cloth draping over the table, three faces are drawn side-by-side, also with wide-open eyes and mouths.  A skull rests on the floor near the lower left corner. The title is written in the center of the margin of the white paper under the image, “Brujas,” and to the right, in brown ink, “à bolar.”

artworks.title: Male Nude Holding a Mirror [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper; the paper has been pricked in several places with the points of a pair of compasses and indented lightly with a stylus

artworks.title: Male Nude with a Lion [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a nude male figure standing upright while facing slightly to his left. The man is positioned with one hand placed on his hip and the other reaching downwards to rest on the head of a large, lion-like creature beside him. The male figure has an athletic build with defined muscles. His head is turned as he looks over his shoulder. His facial features include a strong jawline, pointed nose, and very short hair. There are no clothing items on the figure. The lion-like creature next to him is drawn in considerable detail, with an expressive face and a mane. The background is unadorned and plain, with no significant elements other than a faint indication of landscape lines in the distance. There is a signature mark at the bottom left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Joseph Recounting His Dreams
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered in a room. The composition features multiple figures, engaged in a discussion or teaching scenario. One figure on the right is standing and gesturing with their hand, possibly addressing the seated figures to the left. The background is softly washed, suggesting a dimly lit interior space. The drawing employs loose, expressive lines that capture the movement and attitude of the figures. The balance of dense, detailed areas with more sparsely drawn sections gives a sense of dynamism to the scene. The use of pen, ink, and wash provides depth and contrast, emphasizing certain characters and their interactions.

artworks.title: Archer Drawing a Bow
artworks.medium: black chalk and brown wash, heightened with white and squared for transfer on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a dynamic pose, stretching a bow. The figure has wavy hair, a cap, and is wearing historical or fantasy-inspired clothing. They are seen from the side, with a quiver on their back, aiming an arrow forward.
